title: OpenShot 4.0: Record, Edit, and Color Like Never Before
summary: OpenShot 4.0 is a major release of the popular open-source video editing software, introducing new screen and webcam recording capabilities, enhanced video editing tools, and significantly improved color grading/grading features for professional-quality video production.
problem_solved: Provides free, open-source video editing with recording and professional color grading capabilities that compete with expensive commercial software.
why_valuable: Democratizes video production by offering a complete free editing suite with recording, editing, and color grading tools that were previously only available in premium software.
